description: Perform an orphan page audit on 'https://books.toscrape.com/' using Screaming Frog. 1) Configure the Spider to use the site's sitemap (try 'https://books.toscrape.com/sitemap.xml'). If the site lacks a sitemap, document this failure in the report and instead generate a sitemap using the tool, or proceed with the crawl analysis noting the absence. 2) Crawl the website. 3) Run 'Crawl Analysis' to cross-reference sitemap data against the crawl. 4) Export the 'Orphan Pages' report (or Sitemaps report) to a CSV in '~/Documents/SEO/exports/'. 5) Export the standard 'Internal HTML' report to a CSV in '~/Documents/SEO/exports/'. 6) Write a text report to '~/Documents/SEO/reports/orphan_pages_report.txt' summarizing: total URLs in sitemap, total URLs crawled, number of orphan pages found, and remediation recommendations.
